reason: The free tier already covers what I would use, and I do not pay for subscriptions when a free version exists. I might try the free app for the expiry reminders, but I would not pay.
objection: Another subscription. Most of these apps are free, and I do not want to pay every month for something I can do with a notes app and my own eyes.
would_change_my_mind: If Plus were a one-time payment of a few dollars, or if the free tier had unlimited receipt scans.
